paper.title: Efficient learning by implicit exploration in bandit problems with side observations

settings.name_in_paper: Multi-armed bandit problems with side observations (directed observation system)
unmapped: Paper's d is the number of arms (K here)
Graph G_t chosen by environment each round; learner always observes own loss plus out-neighbours' losses
settings.definition_quote: In each round $t=1,2,\dots,T$, the environment assigns a loss vector $\bloss_t\in[0,1]^\nodes$ for $d$ actions and also selects an observation system described by the directed graph $G_t$. Then ... the learner selects action $I_t$ and subsequently incurs and observes loss $\loss_{t,I_t}$. Furthermore, the learner also observes the losses $\loss_{t,j}$ for all $j$ such that $(I_t \ra j)\in G_t$

unmapped: Semi-bandit feedback on chosen components plus side observations via directed graph on components
Action set S subset of {0,1}^d with ||v||_1 <= m
Learner uses approximations alpha_tilde_t of independence numbers with alpha_t/C <= alpha_tilde_t <= alpha_t
settings.definition_quote: the learner has access to a possibly huge action set $\Sw\subseteq\ev{0,1}^\nodes$ ... we assume that $\onenorm{\bv}\le m$ ... we assume that the learner gets to observe the losses of some other components not included in its own decision vector $\bV_t$ ... given by a directed observability graph $G_t$ ... We refer to this feedback scheme as semi-bandit with side observations.

source.quote: Assume $\gamma_t\le 1/2$ for all $t$ and $\eta_1\ge\eta_2\ge\dots\ge \eta_T$. The regret of \fplix satisfies $R_T \le \frac{m\left(\log d+1\right)}{\eta_T} + 4m \sum_{t=1}^T \eta_t \EE{\tQ_t\pa{\frac{\gamma_t}{1-\gamma_t}}} + \sum_{t=1}^T \gamma_t \EE{\tQ_t(\gamma_t)}$.

results.notes: Generic bound in terms of algorithm parameters; here the learner_knows alpha_G is not needed (only for Corollary 2's tuning).

source.quote: Assume that for all $t\in[T]$, $\alpha_t/C \le \talpha_t \le \alpha_t \le d$ for some $C>1$, and assume $md>4$. Setting $\eta_ t = \gamma_t = \sqrt{\pa{\log{\nodes} + 1}/\pa{m\pa{\nodes+\sum_{s =1}^{t-1}\talpha_s}}}$, the regret of \fplix satisfies $R_T \le H m^{3/2} \sqrt{\pa{d + C\textstyle\sum_{t = 1}^{T} \alpha_t}(\log d + 1)}$, where $H$ is $\OO(\log (mdT))$.

results.notes: Exact bound with factor H = O(log(mdT)); recorded as O with H replaced by log(mdT).
